source: FA2 adds parallelism along the sequence dimension. Different thread blocks can work on different query-row tiles for the same attention head. Because query rows are independent until their own key/value reductions are complete, this exposes more parallel work without changing attention semantics.[5]
zh: FA2 沿序列维度添加并行性。对于相同的注意力头，不同的线程块可以在不同的查询行图块上工作。因为查询行在它们自己的键/值减少完成之前是独立的，所以这在不改变注意语义的情况下公开了更多并行工作。 [5]
